PRIMARY.independent_evidence: The corrected log is 4 C throughout. The release file contains Mira’s independent quality signature but no receiver signature. Two independent signatures are required.
PRIMARY.release_rule: The company release procedure requires current independent quality and receiver signatures before RELEASED may be entered. The Records Manager may assign posting but cannot waive this requirement.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: The authenticated corrected temperature is 4 C throughout. All non-signature release requirements are satisfied; the current signature file supplies the remaining prerequisite.

PRIMARY-CARGO.description: Cargo associated with PRIMARY; standard route is available if released.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.
